name: Bir Pletok
description: A non-alcoholic Betawi heritage drink of ginger, rose syrup, and spices that turns ruby red when shaken.
ingredients: a generous handful of bean sprouts
a handful of fresh Thai basil, chopped
instructions: Combine the jasmine rice and water in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the coriander seeds and lime wedges, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 15 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with coconut cream, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more coconut cream, but you cannot take it away.
